observed_behavior: A knowledge page with a member forbidden by the closed page schema still produces a passed full lint result with zero diagnostics.
expected_behavior: Candidate sealing and full lint validate pages and nested members against the same closed knowledge-page/v1 definition and fail on every contract error.
impact: Non-contract knowledge state can become canonical and influence query, repair, Candidate and portability results with undefined field semantics.

reproduction.symptom_oracle: Any unknown page, claim or source member causes sealing and lint to fail while an unchanged valid page remains lint-clean.
steps: Build a lint-clean isolated knowledge repository.
Add one unknown member to one valid page sidecar.
Compare the closed schema result with full lint diagnostics.
reproduction.sample: Baseline lint passed with zero diagnostics; the closed schema returned one error after the mutation while full lint still passed with zero diagnostics.

root_cause.summary: Runtime governance manually validates selected fields and never invokes the authoritative closed page definition during sealing or full lint.

next_action: Implementation executor adds unknown-member reds for page, claim and source objects, centralizes runtime page schema validation, and reruns BDD-015 plus full suites.
